notes:
T1 energy potion used to establish Inflame and FeelNoPain for later phases; L2 values only immediate HP.
Frame9 PommelStrike damage actual24 predicted19 consistent with unmodelled StrikeDummy plus Vulnerable.
T2 incomplete search crosses shuffle and generation; reveal InfernalBlade first before committing attack order.
T2 establish FeelNoPain for exhaust block across phases instead of single-turn Thunderclap.
T3 threat fallback: observed10x4 predicted20x1; Shockwave weak value absent from L2 frozen threat.
T4 use Thunderclap then drawn Strike: actual StrikeDummy damage permits kill before enemy attacks; frozen L2 misvalues revive timing.
T6 prefer HP-preserving line to survive next intangible turn; start Shrug per HP-only line.
T7 intangible nonattack turn: Bash applies vulnerability for next turn; avoid drawing away next-turn cards for one damage.
T8 use DefendPlus instead of Pommel to retain more HP and topdeck Shrug for next intangible turn.
Result: A3 Act3 floor48 defeated on turn9 phase3. All three potions consumed. L2 single-turn and D2 invoked after each card; manual overrides documented. No kernel changes.
